why: Leaves the issue list in the order GitHub's pages happened to arrive in. Every other field is identical between two exports of an unchanged graph, so this alone would make a scheduled job rewrite the file whenever pagination shifted, and a reader could no longer tell a real change from a reordering. `Array.prototype.sort` is stable, so the no-op comparator preserves input order rather than scrambling it: the mutation is the absence of the sort, not a different sort.
killedBy: buildSnapshot serialises identically whatever order the input arrives in
